main.description: Withdraw a write-notification registration made with com.atproto.space.registerNotify. Idempotent: succeeds whether or not a matching registration existed. Requires a space credential.

space.description: Permissioned space URI, in the form at://{authority}/space/{spaceType}/{skey}. Not a standard at-uri.

service.description: Service identifier of the subscriber to remove, as passed to registerNotify.

endpoint.description: The registered endpoint to remove, when the registration named one rather than a service.

repo.description: When calling a repo host, withdraw the registration for this specific repo rather than the whole space.
